build_edgetam_package: build the EdgeTAM package with pip install -e . including all required dependencies
build_cuda_extension: build the SAM 2 CUDA extension by running python setup.py build_ext with SAM2_BUILD_CUDA=1

review_BuildExtensionIgnoreErrors: review the BuildExtensionIgnoreErrors class that extends BuildExtension to gracefully handle CUDA build failures
